signature.name: VTask.toNonUnitalSubalgebra
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {A : Type u_2} -> [CommSemiring R] -> [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring A] -> [Module R A] -> (p : Submodule R A) -> (h_mul : ∀ (x y : A), x ∈ p → y ∈ p → x * y ∈ p) -> NonUnitalSubalgebra R A

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: This is a total construction; every well-typed pair (p, h_mul) yields a valid NonUnitalSubalgebra with no degenerate or junk-value cases requiring a convention.

facts.statement: ∀ (R A : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring A] [Module R A] (p q : Submodule R A) (hp : ∀ x y : A, x ∈ p → y ∈ p → x * y ∈ p) (hq : ∀ x y : A, x ∈ q → y ∈ q → x * y ∈ q), p ≤ q → VTask.toNonUnitalSubalgebra p hp ≤ VTask.toNonUnitalSubalgebra q hq
